_note: One config per group (ARCHITECTURE §5). Slug `group_id` is load-bearing — it is the output path site/data/<group_id>/ and the URL. `display_name` is cosmetic.
_count_conference_championship_note: Per-group rule (ARCHITECTURE §1/§5): do conference-championship wins settle into a team's season win total? Sportsbooks differ, so it is per-group config, not a code constant. CFBD returns conf-title games as seasonType=regular; the shared cache tags them but excludes nothing — this flag decides. Default false.
_pick_rules_note: Settled format, enforced by validate_team_names.py per group: EXACTLY 4 picks per manager. Always enforced — no unenforced path. Conference spread is ADVISORY for this group and deliberately not gated, matching family and browns: the real 2026 draft was run as four teams and conference spread was never a constraint anyone at the table drafted against, so it must not block the submitted board. `min_distinct_conferences` is therefore 1 (every roster trivially satisfies it). Commissioner decision 2026-08-24, on entry of the real draft — john_wells' roster spans 2 conferences (Virginia/Florida State/California ACC, James Madison Sun Belt) and would have hard-failed the former value of 4. This is deliberately NOT a `conference_minimum_waivers` list: a waiver is a per-manager exemption from a rule the group still keeps, and CEC does not keep this rule at all. That mechanism stays panel's.
_managers_note: Locked real identities; remaining managers added at draft. `manager_id` is the stable join key everywhere — never displayed. `display_name` is cosmetic. Church has two Johns disambiguated by manager_id: john_wells vs john_tamu.
